links.name: Lu4
Bandage Lv. 1 Cures minor bleeding.
Whirlwind Lv. 1 Swings a spear to attack nearby enemies with 554 Power added to P. Atk. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Fatal Strike Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 738 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. Ignores Shield Defence.
Crush of Doom Lv. 1 Attacks enemies in front with 4558 Power added to P. Atk. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Earthquake Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage around user. Power: 3640. Target cancel is possible. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Demolition Impact Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 4026. Applies to enemy: Speed -20%. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Rage Lv. 1 P. Atk. +20% P. Def. -20% Evasion -3. With Two-handed Sword, Two-handed Blunt: additionally P. Atk. +7% Accuracy +2. With Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt, Polearm: additionally P. Atk. +21%.
Battle Roar Lv. 1 Regenerates 12% of the user's original HP and increases the user's Max HP by 12%.
Guts Lv. 1 P. Def. +100% Magic Block Chance +10%.

Frenzy Lv. 1 P. Atk. +30% P. Skills Crit. Damage +30%. With Two-handed Sword, Two-handed Blunt: additionally P. Atk. +25% Accuracy +2. With Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt, Polearm when HP is under 30%: additionally P. Atk. +54%.
Lionheart Lv. 1 Resistance to Paralyze +40% Resistance to Hold +40% Resistance to Sleep +40% Resistance to Stun +40% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks by 40%.

Zealot Lv. 1 Speed +10 P. Skills MP Consumption -50% Resistance to debuffs +80% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +40% Incoming Heal Power -50%. With Sword, Blunt, Fists, Polearm: Accuracy +6 Atk. Spd. +10%. With Sword, Polearm: P. Crit. Rate +33. With Blunt, Fists: P. Crit. Damage +33%.
Dark Form Lv. 1 Fire Atk. Attribute. Resistance to Fire +3%.
Final Secret Lv. 1 Attack Damage in PvP +15% P. Skills Power in PvP and PvE +30%.
Immortality Lv. 1 HP is set to 30% of maximum HP and can't be increased or decreased by any source. Resistance to debuffs +25%. After the effect ends, HP is reduced by 90% of the current amount.

Hammer Crush Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 487 Power to stun an enemy. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. While the effect is active, Resistance to Stun is significantly increased.

Armor Crush Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage around enemy. Power: 3070. Target cancel is possible. Applies to enemy: Stun P. Def. -30% M. Def. -30%. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Pain for Gain Lv. 1 Reduces HP by 70% and limits HP recovery to no more than 20% of the maximum. Decreases Resistance to Debuff by 30%.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Accuracy Lv. 1 Accuracy +3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Fortitude Lv. 1 Resistance to Paralyze +30% Resistance to Stun +30%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Parry Stance Lv. 1 P. Def. +15% M. Def. +15% Speed -5% Atk. Spd. -10% Accuracy -3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Polearm Accuracy Lv. 1 Accuracy +2 when using a spear. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
War Frenzy Lv. 1 Resistance to Stun +5% Resistance to Sleep +10%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Asceticism Lv. 1 While this skill is active, Vampiric-type effects do not restore your health.
Full Swing Lv. 1 With Two-handed Sword: Additional targets +3 Attack Damage in PvP -30%.
Charge Lv. 1 Charges toward an enemy. Consumes 5% of current HP on use. Can't be used with a Bow. Minimal range: 200.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Polearm Mastery Lv. 1 With Polearm: P. Atk. +5 Additional targets +3.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +4 Evasion +3.
Heavy Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +2 Incoming Heal Power +5%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Sword/Blunt Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using one-handed/two-handed Sword or one-handed/two-handed/dual Blunt weapon.
Two-handed Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 and Accuracy by 3 when using a two-handed sword or a two-handed blunt weapon.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Toughness Lv. 1 Resistance to Sleep/Hold/Poison +20%.
Vital Force Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 1.9 when sitting.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Boost HP Lv. 1 Increases Max HP by 60.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Iron Body Lv. 1 Environment-related damage is decreased by 40%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Expose Weak Point Lv. 1 When attacked, 5% chance apply to enemy: P. Def. -20% Received P. Crit. Rate +30%. Duration: 15 sec. Reuse time: 30 sec.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Knock Lv. 1 When using 'Rush', 'Assault', 'Charge', 'Blazing Boost', applies to enemy: Speed -50%.
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Master of Combat Lv. 1 Max CP +3% P. Atk. with Sword/Dual Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt, Polearm, Dual Fist +25.
